en: Praise of the Three Bodies of the Buddha, compiled by the Sages and Holy Ones of the Western Regions.
Translated by Imperial Decree by the Subject Fa-xian, Dharma Master of Mingjiao,
who holds the rank of Chao-san-dafu and Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven Translation Bureau.
I now prostrate to the Buddha of the Dharma-body, Whose universal wisdom is beyond analogy and inconceivable;
Pervading the dharma-realm without obstruction, Profoundly tranquil, peerless, and unequaled;
Whose nature is reality, neither existent nor non-existent, Neither much nor little, transcending all measure and number.
Equal and signless like space, so too are the benefits for oneself and others.
I now prostrate to the Sambhogakāya Buddha, the Great Muni who dwells in profound tranquility;
out of compassion he transforms and delivers the assembly of bodhisattvas, standing in the gathering like the sun shining everywhere.
Having accumulated all merits over three *asaṃkhyeya-kalpas*, you have finally perfected the path of tranquility;
with a great voice, you discourse on the sublime Dharma, universally causing all to attain the fruit of equality.
I now prostrate to the Buddha of Transformation, who attained perfect enlightenment beneath the Bodhi tree;
who sometimes manifests transformations or remains in stillness; who travels to transform beings throughout the ten directions;
who turns the wheel of Dharma in the Deer Park; and who displays a great radiance like a mass of fire.
The bitter retributions of the three miserable realms can all be eliminated; the Great Muni is peerless within the triple world.
Such is the Buddha’s body of untainted wisdom; may I always believe and understand it, purifying my three karmas.
Through immeasurable wisdom and great meritorious conduct, may you look upon all sentient beings with a single mind of compassion.
By means of these verses of praise to the Buddha of the Three Bodies,
may the seeds of untainted merit thus obtained cause me to swiftly realize Buddhahood and lead all sentient beings to return to the Right Path.
Praise of the Three Bodies of the Buddha
